objective: Strengthen meaningful reconciliation scoring behavior (C42.21: 368 generated, 296 killed, 72 survived, 80.4%). Conservative: only high-value Class-A survivors addressed.
strategic_constraint: Do not spend the batch eliminating every equivalent mutant; target genuine scoring/threshold gaps only.
approach: Added 10 deterministic tests for the pure scoring helpers (_calculate_confidence, _simple_description_similarity): exact-date weight (+0.4), within-1-day (+0.3), exact-amount (+0.4), 1.0 cap with similarity, the strictly->0.7 description-similarity boundary, the date-diff tiers, and keyword similarity rules.

validation.targeted_mutation: Manual mutant (description_similarity > 0.7 -> >= 0.7) caught by test_confidence_similarity_boundary_exactly_0_7_excluded (test FAILS on mutant).
validation.method_note: Full component re-measurement is performed by the authoritative CI campaign (Batch 6 trigger).

survivor_classification.class_A_addressed: Confidence weight tiers, 1.0 cap, strictly->0.7 similarity boundary, keyword similarity rule.
survivor_classification.class_B: Equivalent rounding/aggregation mutants on the confidence sum.
